subject.title: [bug]：Gateway pairing failure on Trim OS / TerraMaster NAS: WebSocket closes with code 1002 during device proof response

question: Should this issue proceed as a core Gateway protocol/auth diagnostic repair, a Trim OS package-owner follow-up, or wait for reporter logs before any auth-related code change?
rationale: The remaining unknowns touch Gateway device pairing and shared auth boundaries, and the repository evidence does not prove whether the failure is a stale client protocol, malformed client frame, or external package config rewrite.

options.title: Collect proof first
options.body: Ask for redacted Gateway logs, exact client/Gateway/package versions, the connect protocol range, and before/after generated config before choosing a code or packaging fix.

options.title: Core diagnostic repair
options.body: If logs show current OpenClaw clients produce opaque protocol/auth failures, improve Gateway/CLI diagnostics and docs while preserving auth semantics.

options.title: Route to package owner
options.body: If only trim.openclaw regenerates gateway.auth outside this repository, keep core auth unchanged and route config management to the package owner.

recommendation.title: Collect proof first
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Gateway logs, exact client/Gateway/package versions, the connect protocol range, and before/after generated config before choosing a code or packaging fix.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available history owner for current protocol negotiation and device-auth handshake code.
